description: §6.7.4 the no-write rule: an `<effect>` body that writes a reactive cell directly is E-EFFECT-WRITES-STATE.
rationale: §6.7.4 "The no-write rule": "**An effect body SHALL NOT write any reactive cell, directly or through a called function.** A write found by the analysis below is **E-EFFECT-WRITES-STATE**"; rule 1: "A **direct write** in the body is E-EFFECT-WRITES-STATE." The worked example is this program (`@page = 1` on a `@query` change). ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "`when` → outside-world effects only, spelled `<effect>`" — "your recs, except expound 3b, specifically why the engine restriction."
